accessibility.description: Access routes, permissions and site safety are not measured by built-up land fraction.
accessibility.label: Field access and permissions

albedo.description: Surface reflectivity estimate; sources need compatible definitions and support.
albedo.label: Surface albedo

apparent_thermal_inertia.description: Earth MODIS apparent thermal inertia is not directly equal to Mars TES thermal inertia.
apparent_thermal_inertia.label: Apparent thermal inertia

bare_ground.description: Earth-only bare ground cover. Can filter or express a stated suitability preference; no Mars numerical target.
bare_ground.label: Bare ground cover

biological_activity.description: Microbial abundance, activity and biosignatures are not directly measured by land cover or NDVI.
biological_activity.label: Biological activity and biosignatures

built_cover.description: Earth-only built-up land. Can filter or express a stated suitability preference; no Mars numerical target.
built_cover.label: Built-up land

caves.description: Mars cave candidate classifications and catalog priority, not measured access or terrestrial cave matching.
caves.label: Candidate cave observations

channel_geometry.description: Channel cross sections, bank heights, widths and depths are absent from the supplied drainage summaries.
channel_geometry.label: Fine-scale channel shape

channels.description: Drainage density, mapped-channel proximity or maximum order. Earth rivers and Mars mapped valleys require support/definition review.
channels.label: Channel and valley networks

craters.description: Mars crater inventory. No Earth crater counterpart is listed in this catalog.
craters.label: Impact crater landscape

crop_cover.description: Earth-only crop cover. Can filter or express a stated suitability preference; no Mars numerical target.
crop_cover.label: Crop cover

dunes.description: Mapped dune coverage, proximity and source-specific category; category crosswalk required for type matching.
dunes.label: Dune landscape

dust_loading.description: Airborne dust optical depth, concentration and event statistics are not listed in the schema.
dust_loading.label: Airborne dust concentration

elevation.description: Absolute height relative to the source planetary datum; not local relief. Datums need review.
elevation.label: Absolute elevation

geology.description: Source-specific categorical geology. Numeric class IDs are labels, not continuous distances.
geology.label: Geology and lithology

grain_size.description: Earth estimated effective grain size; no direct Mars field is listed. Central estimate is not explicitly a median.
grain_size.label: Effective soil grain size

grass_cover.description: Earth-only grass cover. Can filter or express a stated suitability preference; no Mars numerical target.
grass_cover.label: Grass cover

ground_ice.description: Source-dependent ground ice estimates. Ice fraction concepts differ by planet; SWIM depth indices are Mars-only.
ground_ice.label: Ground ice and permafrost

ice_depth.description: Actual ice-table depth is not the same as a depth-binned SWIM consistency index; a direct depth measurement is absent.
ice_depth.label: Depth to actual ground ice

land_cover.description: Earth-only dominant land-cover category or provisional surface-not-ground flag.
land_cover.label: Land-cover category

landform.description: Dominant geomorphon or fraction in a named geomorphon class. Valley area is not drainage-network density.
landform.label: Geomorphon landform composition

mangrove_cover.description: Earth-only mangrove cover. Can filter or express a stated suitability preference; no Mars numerical target.
mangrove_cover.label: Mangrove cover

mineral_texture.description: Microscopic texture and preservation potential require measurements beyond broad mineral abundance or spectral indices.
mineral_texture.label: Mineral grain textures and preservation

mineralogy.description: Mars spectral indices/detections and Earth EMIT abundance are different measurements; reviewed conversion required.
mineralogy.label: Mineralogy and spectral indicators

moss_cover.description: Earth-only moss and lichen cover. Can filter or express a stated suitability preference; no Mars numerical target.
moss_cover.label: Moss and lichen cover

open_water.description: Earth-only worldcover open-water cover. Can filter or express a stated suitability preference; no Mars numerical target.
open_water.label: WorldCover open-water cover

pressure.description: Surface atmospheric pressure; spatial and temporal support must be compatible. Wildcard field names are not guessed.
pressure.label: Surface atmospheric pressure

pressure_replicability.description: An open-air Earth site cannot be assumed to reproduce Mars pressure. This catalog supplies no environmental chamber capability.
pressure_replicability.label: Open-air Mars pressure replication

relief.description: Within-region height differences rather than absolute altitude.
relief.label: Relative terrain relief

salinity.description: Salinity and pore-water chemistry are absent. A sulfate abundance estimate does not measure salinity.
salinity.label: Sediment or pore-water salinity

sediment_sorting.description: Within-sample grain-size distributions and sorting are absent. Spatial percentiles of effective grain size do not measure grain sorting.
sediment_sorting.label: Within-sample grain sorting

sediment_transport_flux.description: Particle transport or erosion flux and threshold entrainment measurements are absent. Wind and grain size provide context only.
sediment_transport_flux.label: Particle transport rate

sedimentary_structure.description: Bed thickness, sedimentary structures and stratigraphic logs are not in the schema.
sedimentary_structure.label: Sedimentary layering and bed geometry

shortwave_radiation.description: Downward shortwave radiation; spatial and temporal support must be compatible. Wildcard field names are not guessed.
shortwave_radiation.label: Downward shortwave radiation

shrub_cover.description: Earth-only shrub cover. Can filter or express a stated suitability preference; no Mars numerical target.
shrub_cover.label: Shrub cover

slope.description: Terrain steepness; mean, median, variation, percentiles, and threshold exceedance are distinct representations.
slope.label: Terrain slope

slope_stability.description: Time-dependent stability, landslides and erosion are not directly measured by static roughness or relief.
slope_stability.label: Active slope stability

snow_cover.description: Earth-only snow cover. Can filter or express a stated suitability preference; no Mars numerical target.
snow_cover.label: Snow cover

soil_bearing_strength.description: Mechanical load-bearing, cohesion, friction and traction measurements are absent. Soil texture is only an indirect material proxy.
soil_bearing_strength.label: Soil bearing strength and traction

soil_moisture.description: The supplied schema lacks a direct soil moisture or precipitation/aridity field. Atmospheric column water vapour is not ground moisture.
soil_moisture.label: Near-surface soil moisture

soil_rock_fraction.description: Earth SoilGrids coarse fragments, not exposed boulder abundance, wheel-scale obstacles or bearing strength.
soil_rock_fraction.label: Soil coarse-fragment fraction

soil_texture.description: Earth sand/silt/clay percentages, not measurements of mechanical soil strength.
soil_texture.label: Soil texture

surface_roughness.description: Detrended height residuals or scale-specific K-H roughness; not soil bearing strength or a wheel-scale obstacle inventory.
surface_roughness.label: Surface roughness

surface_temperature.description: Surface temperature; spatial and temporal support must be compatible. Wildcard field names are not guessed.
surface_temperature.label: Surface temperature

terrain_ruggedness.description: Terrain ruggedness index (TRI), not interchangeable with detrended roughness.
terrain_ruggedness.label: Terrain ruggedness index

thermal_inertia.description: TES thermal inertia on Mars. Earth apparent thermal inertia is a different quantity.
thermal_inertia.label: Measured thermal inertia

topographic_position.description: Relative topographic position index, not absolute elevation.
topographic_position.label: Topographic position index

tree_cover.description: Earth-only tree cover. Can filter or express a stated suitability preference; no Mars numerical target.
tree_cover.label: Tree cover

vegetation_cover.description: Earth vegetation cover for exposure, biological interference or field access. Cover classes are not biomass, microbes or a Mars vegetation measurement.
vegetation_cover.label: Vegetation cover composition

vegetation_index.description: Earth MODIS NDVI; vegetation cover fractions are different measurements.
vegetation_index.label: Vegetation index

water_chemistry.description: Water pH, alkalinity and dissolved composition are absent from the supplied schema.
water_chemistry.label: Water and pore-fluid chemistry

water_mask.description: Earth-only terrain water-mask coverage. Can filter or express a stated suitability preference; no Mars numerical target.
water_mask.label: Terrain water-mask coverage

water_vapour.description: Atmospheric column water vapour; spatial and temporal support must be compatible. Wildcard field names are not guessed.
water_vapour.label: Atmospheric column water vapour

wetland_cover.description: Earth-only wetland cover. Can filter or express a stated suitability preference; no Mars numerical target.
wetland_cover.label: Wetland cover

wheel_scale_obstacles.description: Obstacle dimensions, spacing, sharpness and slope discontinuities at rover wheel scale are absent. Terrain DEM summaries and SoilGrids fragments do not replace this measurement.
wheel_scale_obstacles.label: Wheel-scale obstacle geometry

wind.description: Wind speed; spatial and temporal support must be compatible. Wildcard field names are not guessed.
wind.label: Wind speed

ontology.caution: Orbital terrain and soil summaries cannot establish wheel-scale safety.
Static consistency does not establish time-dependent stability.
Modern Earth rivers and Mars paleovalleys differ in process age and mapping support.
Surface soil is only a candidate proxy for ancient deposited material.
Wind and particle context alone do not supply sediment flux or equal transport thresholds across planets.
SWIM is consistency evidence; Earth permafrost fractions are not interchangeable with Martian ice fractions.
Land-cover fractions do not measure microbial abundance.
Column vapour is not precipitation, soil moisture or a calibrated aridity index.
Local time, season, surface skin temperature and observation support must be aligned.
An Earth abundance is not equal to a Mars detection count or spectral index.
Crater inventory is Mars-only in this schema.
Candidate-cave labels do not establish access or Earth cave counterparts.
Minerals and land cover do not directly establish biosignature preservation.
